_nota: Fuentes: Corporación Lindley (llegada al Perú en 1910-1911, Inca Kola en 1935); en 1999 The Coca-Cola Company compró el 49 % de la marca Inca Kola (los derechos fuera del Perú).
inca01-peru: a cinematic aerial view of Lima Peru at golden hour with the Pacific coast, warm light
inca02-lindley: a small 1910s bottling workshop in Lima with glass bottles and a family of english immigrants, sepia warm light
inca03-amarilla: a glass bottle of bright yellow soda on a table next to fresh lemon verbena leaves, 1930s style, warm light
inca04-nombre: a yellow soda bottle standing on top of ancient Inca stone walls in Cusco, golden hour, epic
inca05-mesa: a peruvian family lunch table with ceviche, lomo saltado and glasses of yellow soda, joyful, warm light
inca06-publicidad: a giant red billboard at a busy 1990s Lima avenue at night, traffic lights, neon
inca07-giro: a corporate boardroom table at night with two businessmen shaking hands, city lights behind, dramatic
inca08-compra: two soda bottles, one red and one yellow, standing side by side on a table, dramatic spotlight
inca09-final: a bottle of yellow soda on a table with the peruvian andes at sunset behind, epic warm light
